# GPU/CommandBuffer

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [CommandBuffer.h](CommandBuffer.h): An off-screen command buffer: records compute and fill work that has no drawable to present. (declares `CommandBuffer`)
- [Copy.h](Copy.h): A texel position inside one level of one slice. (declares `TextureOrigin`, `TextureExtent`, `TextureCopyRegion`, `BufferTextureCopy`)
- [CopyPlan.h](CopyPlan.h): A copy checked against both resources and reduced to numbers every backend records as they stand: no zero sizes left to resolve, nothing out of range. (declares `TextureCopyPlan`, `BufferCopyPlan`, `BufferTextureCopyPlan`, `textureSlices`, `levelWidth`, `levelHeight`, `levelSlices`, `planTextureCopy`, `planWholeTextureCopy`, `planBufferCopy`, `planMipGeneration`, `planBufferTextureCopy`)
- [CopyRecorder.h](CopyRecorder.h): Each backend's half of a copy, recorded onto `recording`: the id<MTLCommandBuffer> on Metal, the CommandContext* on D3D12 and Vulkan, as Frame::nativeRecording and CommandBuffer::nativeRecording hand them out. (declares `recordCopy`, `recordCopyToTexture`, `recordCopyToBuffer`, `recordMipGeneration`)
